item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Medication. Taking it consistently matters more than taking it perfectly. Tie it to something you already do every day, like your morning routine, so it doesn't rely on memory or willpower. If you miss a dose, don't spiral or pile on guilt. Just get back on schedule at the next one. Skipping or changing doses on your own is risky, so bring questions to your prescriber. Action: set one daily phone alarm for your dose, today.
